file_roles.evidence: Diff wraps commitOffsetsOrTransaction in try/catch; on RuntimeException it adds tasks to dirtyTasks and clears checkpointPerTask so they are closed dirty instead of being skipped.

rationale: The IllegalStateException is thrown later when a store is re-initialised and its metrics recorder was never removed. The reporter says a commit failure during close skipped the close call. TaskManager's close path is changed to always close tasks dirty on commit failure.
